title: More Decorative Than Anything
text:
More Decorative Than Anything. I really wanted to like these. All my pans are nonstick I can't use metal in them and the plastic stuff I keep getting is flimsy and useless. I hoped these wood utensils would be just what I needed.
Unfortunately these are more for display and decorations than even casual let alone serious cooking. They remind me of kids toys. Overly thick edges dulled points so no one gets hurt. In the old days they'd make a good knuckle cracker or rear-end swatter but for cooking these are pretty much useless.
